body: Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences announced the initiation of the 12th batch of the Certificate Course on Marma Chikitsa at NARIP, Cheruthuruthy.
department: Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences
markdown_body:
# Marma Chikitsa Certificate Course Admission 2026
Meta Description: Apply now for the 12th Marma Chikitsa certificate course at NARIP Cheruthuruthy. Learn, get certified, train under experts. Apply by Sep 5, 2026.
### Short Introduction (100 words max)
NARIP Cheruthuruthy invites applications for the 12th batch of the Certificate Course on Marma Chikitsa (CCMC). The one‑month program runs in May and October. It is open to BAMS graduates with no age limit. Candidates receive training in theory and practice of Marma therapy, with hands‑on sessions, expert faculty, and a certificate accredited by ATAB. Apply by September 5, 2026 for a first‑come, first‑serve admission.
### 📅 Important Dates | Event | Date | |-------|------| | Application Deadline | 05.09.2026 | | May Batch | May (Annual) | | October Batch | October (Annual) |
### 💼 Vacancy Details
20 seats per batch for Certificate Course on Marma Chikitsa (CCMC).
### 👤 Eligibility Criteria
1. BAMS degree from any recognized university.
2. No age limit.
3. Medium of instruction: Hindi or English.
### 📊 Age Limit Table | Post | Age | Birth Range | |----------|-----|-------------| | Certificate Course on Marma Chikitsa | No upper limit | N/A |
### 💰 Application Fee Details + payment methods
Course fee: Rs 15,000 for Indian nationals. Payment via Demand Draft drawn on SBI, Shoranur (IFSC: SBIN0000760) or bank transfer to account 10347493316.
### 🧭 Selection Process
1. Application screening.
2. Merit‑based selection by Director/In‑charge.
3. Final admission Decision.
### 💵 Salary & Benefits Year-wise breakdown
N/A – No salary or remuneration provided.
### 📝 How to Apply (7 Steps)
1. Visit http://www.ccras.nic.in to download the application form.
2. Fill all details in the form.
3. Attach BAMS degree certificate and Medical Registration Certificate.
4. Email the completed form to ccmc.narip@gmail.com or nrip.cheruthuruthy@gmail.com.
5. Submit before the deadline of 05.09.2026.
6. Applications are processed on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis.
7. Admission is granted by the Director.
### 📂 Required Documents
- BAMS degree certificate.
- Medical Registration Certificate.
### ✅ Why Apply Now? 
- Learn ancient Marma therapy.
- Get certified by ATAB.
- Train under experienced faculty.
- Gain practical hands‑on experience.
- Boost your Ayurveda career.
### 🧠 Preparation Tips
1. Review basic Marma concepts.
2. Study relevant Ayurvedic textbooks.
3. Practice hands‑on techniques.
4. Prepare for the MCQ theory exam.
5. Gather required documents early.
6. Submit your application before the deadline.
### ❓ FAQs (6 Questions)
**Q1:** Who can apply? **A:** BAMS graduates with no age limit.
**Q2:** What is the course fee? **A:** Rs 15,000 for Indian nationals.
**Q3:** How can the fee be paid? **A:** By DD or bank transfer as described.
**Q4:** What is the duration of the course? **A:** One month, conducted in May and October.
**Q5:** Is hostel accommodation provided? **A:** No, candidates must arrange their own accommodation.
**Q6:** What is the selection criterion? **A:** First‑come‑first‑serve basis after application review.
### 🎯 Final Call-to-Action
Apply now before 05.09.2026! Download the form at http://www.ccras.nic.in and email it to ccmc.narip@gmail.com.
